info.title: Personal Agent API
info.description: HTTP API for building clients on top of the Personal Agent over Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy 1.0): multi-company conversations, quick replies, Operations v3 approval workflows, Company OAuth sign-in, real-time SSE events, and passkey-backed multi-device accounts. Browser clients authenticate via same-origin cookies; native apps send no `Origin` header and authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`.

tags.name: Conversations
tags.description: Create and interact with conversations across up to three connected Companies. Each turn returns newly added messages alongside the updated `ConversationState`.

tags.name: Company sign-ins
tags.description: Authenticate a user directly on a Company's own consent page without exposing credentials to the agent. Final outcomes arrive over the SSE event stream.

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Real-time Server-Sent Events stream delivering sign-in outcomes and the questions after them, proposal updates, cross-device activity, and a Company's Direct Conversation messages once a request has read them.

tags.name: Accounts
tags.description: Create passwordless, passkey-backed agent accounts and inspect or claim conversations across devices.

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Authenticate devices with discoverable WebAuthn passkeys and rotate short-lived bearer and refresh tokens.

tags.name: Passkeys
tags.description: Register additional WebAuthn passkeys on an account or remove compromised ones (ending every session they started).

tags.name: Devices
tags.description: List active browser and app sessions (up to 25 per account) and revoke one or all devices.

tags.name: Channels
tags.description: Link external messaging channels to an account using short-lived, single-use codes.

get.description: Lists everything that waits for the user across their running conversations, newest conversation first: proposals to approve or decline, sign-ins to finish or do again, and questions the agent asked. For an inbox: open the item's `conversation` to act on it there. Ended conversations, and decided, answered or expired items, are left out.

200.description: Turn completed. As JSON, the `TurnResult`. With `Accept: text/event-stream`, Server-Sent Events (`TurnEvent`): one `message.delta` per sentence of the agent's as it is written, then `turn` with the same result, or `error`. A request refused before anything was said is answered as without the header, with its status and an `Error`.

post.description: Approves or declines a pending Operations v3 proposal. Approvals bind strictly to `revision` and execute at most once. A decline is kept by the agent; nothing is sent to the Company. If the Company answers the approval with other terms, nothing is performed: the answer is 409 `terms_changed`, and the proposal waits again at a new `revision` (or, when the Company gave the new terms another ID, this one becomes `superseded` and a new proposal waits).

company.description: Origin URL of the Company holding the proposal.

revision.description: Exact `revision` token from the proposal shown to the user.

410.description: The conversation has ended (`conversation_ended`), or the proposal expired or was already decided (`proposal_expired`).

post.description: Initiates Direct Sign-In (§4.2) at a connected Company. Browser callers receive the Company's consent URL; bearer-authenticated apps receive a single-use agent link (`SignIn.url`) to open in an in-app browser session. Completion emits `signin.completed` or `signin.failed` on the event stream.

get.description: Opened by a native app's browser (`SignIn.url`). Consumes the one-time 3-minute ticket, binds the OAuth state to that browser via cookie, and redirects to the Company's consent page. Expired, reused, revoked-session, or mismatched-account tickets redirect to `endUrl?result=failed`.

303.description: Redirects to the Company's consent page, or to `endUrl?result=failed`.

get.description: Opens a Server-Sent Events stream starting with `state`, followed by incremental changes polled every 2 seconds. Closes automatically after 5 minutes or when the conversation ends; reconnect and resync from `state`. Signed-in streams emit `session.ended` if the session or access token becomes invalid. Concurrency is capped at 10 open streams per account (4 per anonymous visitor, `too_many_streams`).

get.description: Returns this OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification as JSON.

CompanyRef.description: Identifies a Company by its origin and display name.

company.description: Origin URL of the Company holding the proposal.

proposal.description: Unique proposal ID issued by the Company.

revision.description: Exact revision token shown to the user for approval.

ProposalRef.description: References a specific proposal at an exact revision. Approvals bind strictly to `revision`.

Answer.description: Structured payload carried by a quick-reply `Choice`. Must contain exactly one member; Companies are referenced by origin and values are never parsed as free text. `approve` and `decline` decide a proposal at its exact revision; `signin` tells the client to call `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/sign-ins`; `signout` signs out of that Company; `resume` retries the request that waited for sign-in; `invitation` accepts or declines a Direct Conversation.

company.description: Selects an already-connected Company by origin.

connect.description: Connects a new Company by origin URL.

keep.description: Keeps only the listed Company origins when replacing a full conversation.

message.description: Sends a scripted prompt text as the user's turn.

company.description: Origin URL of the Company to sign in to.

signin.description: Prompts the client to start a Company sign-in flow.

signout.description: Origin URL of the Company to sign out from.

resume.description: Origin URL of the Company whose pending request should resume after sign-in.

company.description: Origin URL of the Company that sent the invitation.

accept.description: `true` to open a Direct Conversation; `false` to decline.

invitation.description: Responds to a Company's invitation to speak directly with the user.

label.description: Short button label to display to the user.

answer.description: Structured payload to submit to `POST /api/v1/conversations/{id}/answers` when chosen.

Choice.description: A quick-reply button attached to an agent message. Render `label` and submit `answer` verbatim. The user may also answer the question in words with `sendMessage` ("yes", "no", "approve the Lantern one"): the agent's code, never a model, reads a short answer to the question just asked, and any other message drops the question.

text.description: Plain-language summary of what the agent did.

how.description: Channel or phase used for this step.

access.description: Access level used for this step, or `null` for signed-out calls.

company.description: Origin URL of the Company involved, when applicable.

args.description: Sanitized JSON summary of arguments sent to the Company.

AgentStep.description: One protocol action taken during a turn, shown in the activity trace.

id.description: Only in a turn streamed with `Accept: text/event-stream`, on each of the agent's messages: the ID its `message.delta` events named. Match it to the sentences shown, and drop shown sentences whose ID no message carries.

from.description: Speaker role. `agent` without `company` is the agent's own system voice; `company` is untrusted Company content.

text.description: Message body in plain text or light Markdown.

spoken.description: Voice-ready version of `text` (one or two short sentences, no Markdown or IDs, spoken currency). Generated deterministically, never by a model. Only on the agent's messages: a Company's words are never rewritten.

company.description: Company this message is from or about.

using.description: Companies consulted while producing this reply.

author.description: Company-provided author label, such as a support agent.

direct.description: `true` when sent inside a Direct Conversation (§8.10).

links.description: Safe HTTPS links surfaced by the turn.

steps.description: Protocol steps executed during this turn.

data.description: Pretty-printed structured payload attached to a message.

proposals.description: Proposals that arrived with this message, at the revision they came with. A client that shows proposals as cards shows each one after this message, found in `ConversationState.proposals` by `company` and `proposal`, and keeps it there once it is decided.

AgentMessage.description: A single message in the conversation transcript.

conversation.description: ID of the conversation it waits in.

kind.description: `proposal`: a Company holds a change for the user's approval. `signin`: a Company sign-in to finish or to do again. `question`: the agent asked, and the user's next message or a quick reply answers.

company.description: Company it is at, when it is at one.

text.description: What it is, in the agent's own words (never a Company's summary), such as `Approve or decline the $88.00 change`.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which it no longer waits, when it runs out on its own.

revision.description: Exact revision a decision binds to.

proposal.description: For a `proposal`: which one, to decide with `decideProposal`.

PendingItem.description: One thing that waits for the user. Decided, answered and expired items are not listed.

signedIn.description: `true` when the user has an active OAuth grant.

signingIn.description: `true` while a sign-in flow is in progress.

consentVersion.description: Monotonic counter incremented each time consent is granted or upgraded.

accessLost.description: `true` when the Company revoked or rejected the stored grant.

open.description: `true` while a Direct Conversation is active.

invitation.description: Reason text for a pending Direct Conversation invitation, or `null`.

direct.description: Direct Conversation status for this Company.

CompanyState.description: Connection, authentication, and Direct Conversation state for one Company.

id.description: Operation ID issued by the Company.

revision.description: Exact revision token required when approving. Changes if terms shift.

summary.description: Company-authored plain-text summary of the change.

terms.description: Authoritative structured terms computed by the Company (amounts, dates, balances).

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the operation.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which the proposal cannot be approved.

result.description: Outcome message or refusal reason once resolved.

spoken.description: Agent-generated spoken description derived from `terms` (never the Company's summary).

Proposal.description: A state-changing operation held by a Company for explicit user approval (Operations v3). Nothing executes until approved.

active.description: `true` while open; `false` once ended and read-only.

keptUntil.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when an ended conversation is purged from storage.

removed.description: Companies previously disconnected from this conversation.

proposals.description: All proposals raised in this conversation.

ConversationState.description: Complete snapshot of a conversation, its connected Companies, transcript, and proposals.

messages.description: Messages added during this turn (or the full list when `replaced` is `true`).

replaced.description: `true` when earlier messages were withdrawn (for example after losing access or disconnecting a Company).

TurnResult.description: Result of a completed message or quick-reply turn.

type.description: Always `message.delta`; also the SSE event name.

message.description: ID of the agent message this sentence belongs to; the `turn` event's message with this `id` holds the whole text.

index.description: Position of the sentence within its message, from 0.

text.description: The sentence as written, with the whitespace around it, so the texts of one message joined are its text. Ends at a stop, a line's end, or a clause or space before about 220 characters; never inside a word.

spoken.description: The sentence to read aloud, made by the same fixed rules as a message's `spoken`. Empty when it holds nothing to say, such as a table row or a bare address.

MessageDelta.description: One sentence of one of the agent's messages, sent as soon as it is written. A voice client speaks `spoken` as each one arrives.

TurnEvent.description: One Server-Sent Event of a turn streamed with `Accept: text/event-stream`; `type` matches the SSE `event:` field. `message.delta` events come first, one per sentence, then exactly one `turn` or `error`. Only the agent's words come as sentences: Company content comes whole in the result as its own message (§10.1). Demo-mode answers and the agent's own lines, which are ready at once, come as sentences too, all together just before `turn`.

type.description: Always `turn`; the last event of a turn that ended.

result.description: The same result as the JSON answer; each agent message carries the `id` its sentences named.

oneOf.description: The turn ended: show `result` in place of the sentences shown.

type.description: Always `error`; the last event of a turn that failed after it began.

status.description: The HTTP status the JSON answer would have had.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, when there is one.

error.description: User-facing explanation that can be shown as is.

oneOf.description: The turn failed after its first sentence: drop the sentences shown and show `error`.

provider.description: Model backend: `demo` (scripted examples, no LLM), `free` (deployment's Workers AI model), or bring-your-own-key (`openai-compatible`, `anthropic`).

apiKey.description: Provider API key for `openai-compatible` or `anthropic`. Sent per request and never stored.

model.description: Optional model identifier for bring-your-own-key providers.

turnstile.description: Single-use Cloudflare Turnstile token required for `free` turns, made by the deployment's widget on its own host for the action `chat`. Missing, invalid, or over-quota turns fall back to `demo` with an explanatory note.

ModelChoice.description: Selects which model handles a turn. Defaults to `demo` when omitted.

proposal.description: Updated proposal after applying the decision.

Decision.description: Outcome of approving or declining a proposal.

url.description: URL to open for consent. For browsers: the Company's consent page. For apps: a single-use agent link to open in `ASWebAuthenticationSession` (or equivalent).

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when an app sign-in link expires (3 minutes).

endUrl.description: Fixed callback completion URL an app watches for (`?result=done` or `?result=failed`).

SignIn.description: Details for launching a Company OAuth sign-in flow. The agent never sees the user's password; final status arrives on the SSE event stream.

AgentEvent.description: One Server-Sent Event payload. `type` matches the SSE `event:` field; the initial event is always `state`.

type.description: Event type and SSE event name.

keptUntil.description: Unix timestamp (ms) until an ended conversation is purged. Present on `conversation.ended`.

code.description: Present on `session.ended`: `invalid_token` means refresh the access token and reconnect; `session_revoked` means sign in again.
Stable machine-readable error code for programmatic handling.

error.description: Plain-language error message safe to show to the user.

Error.description: Standard error envelope returned on 4xx and 5xx responses.

id.description: Unique passkey identifier within the account.

name.description: Device description captured when the passkey was registered.

created.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the passkey was added.

lastUsed.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the passkey was last used to sign in.

synced.description: `true` when the authenticator reports multi-device passkey backup.

Passkey.description: Metadata for a WebAuthn passkey registered on an account. Public keys are never returned.

label.description: Optional user-chosen label for the account.

created.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the account was created.

linked.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the channel was linked.

channels.description: External channels linked via one-time link codes.

session.description: Session ID authenticating the current request.

unclaimed.description: Browser-only count of anonymous pre-sign-in conversations available to claim.

Account.description: An anonymous passkey-backed agent account. Holds no email or password.

accessToken.description: Short-lived bearer token (~15 min). Send in `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

refreshToken.description: Single-use rotating refresh token. Reusing a spent token revokes the entire session.

SessionTokens.description: Bearer and rotating refresh tokens issued to native client apps. Store in the OS keychain; never log or place in URLs.

tokens.description: Returned only to native apps (requests without an `Origin` header); browsers receive an `HttpOnly` cookie.

SignedIn.description: Returned after creating an account or signing in with a passkey.

ceremony.description: Opaque single-use ceremony ID to echo back within 5 minutes.

CreationOptions.description: Challenge and WebAuthn creation options for registering a new passkey.

ceremony.description: Opaque single-use ceremony ID to echo back within 5 minutes.

RequestOptions.description: Challenge and WebAuthn request options for usernameless passkey sign-in.

ceremony.description: Ceremony ID received from the corresponding `/options` call.

device.description: Optional device label shown in the sessions list (e.g. "iPhone" or "Chrome on macOS").

PasskeyAnswer.description: Completes a passkey registration or sign-in ceremony.

created.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the session started.

lastUsed.description: Unix timestamp (ms) of the last authenticated request.

expires.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the session expires.

current.description: `true` for the session authenticating this request.

Session.description: An active device session signed in to an account.

code.description: Formatted 8-character one-time code to enter in the channel.

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp (ms) when the code expires (5 minutes).

LinkCode.description: Single-use code linking an external messaging channel to an account.

apiSession.description: Short-lived access token from `SessionTokens` (`Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`). Browser clients on the playground's origin authenticate with `HttpOnly` cookies instead.
